messages:
anna (sales): Quick sync: NordBank signed the NDA and wants a 3-week POC. Hard requirements: EU-only egress for all customer data, list of subprocessors + certs, BYOK (AWS KMS), and a preliminary Dedicated pricing for 3 p50s (they expect bursty inference) — also must include documented failover semantics. Who can help reply to the RFP template?

diego (solutions): I can draft the RFP answers. Clarify: when they say EU-only, do they want strict reject-on-cross-border or EU-fallback (i.e., failover within EU only)?

anna (sales): They literally said "no cross-border tolerated" unless we have an explicit signed SOP for DR. So default should be reject rather than failover to non-EU.

sora (eng): We can support tenant-level geo-pin + an egress policy. Options we can offer: 
1) strict-eu: reject if local EU capacity unavailable
2) eu-failover-strict: failover to another EU region only
3) eu-queue: queue requests for X seconds then reject.
Pick one for the POC. For NordBank I recommend option 2 (eu-failover-strict) to give some resiliency while staying in EU.

leah (security): Subprocessor list for EU scope here: AWS/eu-west-1 (infra), GCP/europe-west3 (backup), Cloudflare (WAF/edge), Fastly (optional CDN), Datadog (metrics). I attached the signed subproc pack. We can provide SOC2 Type II or ISO27001 certs for each where available.

ops-bot: Uploaded: subproc-pack-nordbank-eu-2026-03.pdf -> https://files.redwood.co/subproc-pack-nordbank-eu-2026-03.pdf

matt (finance): Preliminary POC pricing for 3-week engagement, 3x p50 reserved (pro-rate), enterprise networking, BYOK add-on, and SRE on-call: rough ballpark = USD 40k for the 3 weeks (includes trial credit offset). I'll produce a line-item breakdown for proposal.

anna (sales): Good enough to start the proposal. Diego, can you assemble a short BYOK blurb + the egress routing snippet and attach the subproc pack + Matt's price breakdown? I'll attach to the RFP template.

diego (solutions): Yup. Draft BYOK blurb: 
```
We support Customer-Managed KMS (BYOK) for Dedicated and Private deployments. Flow summary:
1) Customer provisions CMK in their AWS account and shares Key ARN.
2) Customer creates cross-account IAM role with limited Encrypt/Decrypt permissions.
3) Redwood configures key usage; all encryption/decryption calls are proxied to customer's KMS.
Notes: Cross-account access requires an addendum. If customer requires absolute zero-key-access, recommend Private (self-hosted) runtime.
```

diego (solutions): Routing snippet (ops will apply):
```
tenant_id: nordbank-prod
region_preference: eu-west-1
egress_policy: eu-only
failover_policy: eu-region-failover-only
max_queue_time_s: 10
kms_mode: customer-managed
```

leah (security): Also include auditability statement: we can provide per-request region tags, per-request egress path logs, and a KMS access log extracted from the customer's account. We'll bundle certificate copies for subprocessors.

anna (sales): Great. One more ask from NordBank: can we guarantee subnet-level isolation for the Dedicated nodes (VPC peering) during the POC?

sora (eng): Yes — for Dedicated we can provision in a customer-allocated VPC or peer into our Dedicated VPCs with strict routing. Ops will need 3 business days after sign-off to provision. Submit PROV ticket after contract.

ops-bot: Reminder: create provisioning ticket after PO acceptance -> PROV-9187

matt (finance): I'll send the pro-forma with line-items (3x p50 pro-rate, network egress caps, BYOK admin fee, SRE on-call flat fee). If they want longer retention for logs we can add an observability retention addon.

anna (sales): Perfect. Diego — drop the draft answers here and I'll attach to the RFP doc. Call out: strict EU egress + eu-failover-only for POC, BYOK with addendum, subproc pack link, pricing ballpark. Send within 90 minutes pls.

diego (solutions): Will post draft in ~45m.

ops-bot: Note: For EU-only POCs, compliance requires signed SOP for DR & emergency procedures. Ops contact: @sora for provisioning ETA.

anna (sales): Thanks team. I'll wait for Diego's draft before sending to customer. :pray:
